data.name: Humrahtun
data.gender_notes: Humrahtun is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A name derived from the Arabic word 'Humrah', meaning 'sweet fragrance'. This name is often given to babies born during the spring season, symbolizing the sweet scent of blooming flowers. The name Humrahtun carries the meaning “Sweet Fragrance” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Humrahtun usually hope their child will grow to embody sweet fragrance and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Represents the sweetness and fragrance of the soul, bringing joy and positivity to those around them.
data.etymology: Humrahtun belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Sweet Fragrance.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Humrahtun total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.
